key_highlights: ASX retreats as energy shares slump, AI doubts pressure miners, and consumer discretionary names suffer sharp declines.
Macroeconomic indicators flash caution with Australian flash PMI plunging into contraction and AUD hit by growth shocks.
Banking sector steps up cost-reduction efforts, led by Westpac job cuts amid falling house prices and private credit stress.
Energy transition economics challenged by Snowy 2.0 capital expenditure blowout to $25 billion.

sectors.trend: Softening sentiment in bulk commodities with emerging supply threats hitting iron ore majors and cautious gold capital raisings.
sectors.implications: Heightened margin compression for high-cost producers; investors reward low-cost producers and balance sheet discipline.

sectors.trend: Severe volatility driven by crude oil swings and massive infrastructure cost blowouts.
sectors.implications: Snowy 2.0 Capex inflation ($25b) clouds transition economics; oil price gyrations dampen upstream earnings visibility.

sectors.trend: Major banks pursue headcount reductions to defend margins against deteriorating mortgage demand and property debt default risks.
sectors.implications: Westpac restructuring underscores cost control focus as mortgage arrears and developer credit risks escalate.

sectors.trend: Discretionary retail earnings deteriorate sharply while supermarkets navigate regulatory and cost-of-living scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Nick Scali plunge signals household pullback; defensive positioning in non-discretionary staples remains prudent.

sectors.trend: Heightened valuation scrutiny following AI exuberance and high-profile tech sector wealth wipeouts.
sectors.implications: Capital rotating toward established infrastructure and data centre operators with proven cash generation over speculative growth.

sectors.trend: Accelerating nationwide residential price falls and private credit failures among residential developers.
sectors.implications: Asset write-down risks for property portfolios and tightening non-bank liquidity across residential projects.

key_themes: Stagflationary warning signs from red-zone flash PMI and AUD growth shock
Corporate margin defense through banking job cuts and capital rationing
Commodity price divergence and iron ore supply headwinds
Property market correction gathering pace with private credit contagion

risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase allocations to defensive consumer staples, utilities, and high-quality liquid short-term paper.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property Market & Private Credit Liquidity Freeze
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid leveraged property developers and unrated private credit; focus on high-occupancy prime REITs.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron Ore Price Degradation & Pilbara Margin Squeeze
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight pure-play high-cost iron ore miners in favor of diversified miners with strong balance sheets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Public & Private Energy Transition Capex Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid engineering and utility firms exposed to unhedged fixed-price EPC contracts.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Defensive Gold and Copper Producers
opportunities.rationale: Precious metals hedge against currency growth shocks and equity volatility while copper benefits from discounted acquisition values.
Heavy rainfall driving cattle herd rebuilding and surge in livestock prices, supporting rural agribusiness earnings.

opportunities.recommendation: Long-Term Positioning in Core Western Sydney Airport Infrastructure
opportunities.rationale: Despite slow-burn ramp-up, critical transport and industrial logistics hubs will compound value long term.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Divest Discretionary Retail and Furniture Equities
defensive_moves.rationale: High mortgage burdens and falling property prices accelerate household spending contraction, as seen in Nick Scali.
Flash PMI slump and commodities pressure signal elevated risk of broader index correction.
Growing competitive supply and subdued Chinese demand place Fortescue margins at risk.

market_outlook.short_term: 1–3 month ASX outlook: Bearish. ASX 200 faces headwinds from contracting manufacturing and service activity, weak AUD growth dynamics, and consumer spending pullbacks.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month medium-term outlook: Neutral to cautious. Anticipated RBA rate cuts could provide a floor in 2027, but mounting fiscal debt and structural infrastructure overruns restrain a sharp rebound.
key_catalysts: RBA board interest rate decision and revised economic forecasts
Next quarterly Australian CPI release and wage price index data
Chinese industrial production data and iron ore benchmark price trends

Federal mid-year economic and fiscal outlook (MYEFO) budget deficit updates
